fields.title: Collections are here
fields.excerpt: Posts, products and categories: reusable content with typed fields, references and lists.

features.title: Typed fields
features.body: Each collection declares its fields with the same helpers as bricks.

features.title: References
features.body: A product points at its category by id, so renaming never breaks links.

features.title: Lists
features.body: Bricks can load documents, like the latest posts on the home page.
